prompt_fields.subject: A small cluster of two to three thin pale sedge-green reed or grass tufts emerging just above the waterline, sparse and delicate, no thick stems.
prompt_fields.palette: Muted pale sedge-green and straw tones, restrained tabletop-material palette, no bright saturated color.
prompt_fields.contrast: Purely decorative -- must read as harmless floating or emergent vegetation, never as a wall, fence, raised obstacle or speed-boosting pad. Distinct in shape from the moss-clump (bog-misc-2) and driftwood (bog-misc-3) variants so the three read as different decorations, not recolors of one shape.
prompt_fields.composition: Low, flat silhouette hugging the waterline; the whole motif must stay inside a transparent margin on all four sides and must not read as tall enough to block sight. It sits at the water surface, so it is not required to fill the canvas's lower 25% the way an upright tree trunk is.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Zero rule difference from plain bog water: does not block movement, sight, sense or ESP; no hazard. Do not paint anything implying blocking, bonus movement or hazard -- no glow, no bubbles, no spikes, no poison tint.

prompt_fields.subject: A single short, weathered, partially submerged driftwood branch or broken log fragment lying diagonally across part of the water surface, dark textured bark, no leaves, clearly broken and irregular rather than a straight milled plank.
prompt_fields.palette: Dark weathered brown-grey wood tones, matching a restrained tabletop-material palette.
prompt_fields.contrast: Purely decorative, must read as harmless flotsam, never as a wall or raised obstacle. Distinct in shape from the reed cluster (bog-misc-1) and moss clump (bog-misc-2).
prompt_fields.composition: The log must be short relative to the tile and clearly broken/irregular in outline, angled diagonally rather than spanning the full tile edge-to-edge; do not draw a continuous straight plank that reaches two opposite tile edges, which would visually invent a bridge or crossing that this grid does not provide. Stay inside a transparent margin on all four sides.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Zero rule difference from plain bog water: does not block movement, sight, sense or ESP, and grants no special crossing or speed bonus -- swimming/wading through this tile is exactly as easy or hard as through plain bog water. No hazard.
